640:t_1:249.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's right, $$ノノ$$. We're warriors who protect Earth, after all.」

640:t_1:250.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm sure we'll see $$ラルク$$ again someday. Let's keep doing our best until then.」

640:t_1:253.en:
$$ノノ$$
(...'I'm... not your Big Sis...' In the end, I'm leaving without getting to ask what she meant by those words...)

640:t_1:254.en:
$$ノノ$$
(But $$ノノ$$ believes... that we'll meet again in the sea of stars, no matter what...)

640:t_2:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Its name is $$エル・ミレニウム$$. It is an emissary of judgment.」

640:t_3:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've confirmed the completion of $$スヴェル$$. The remaining enemy units appear to have touched the barrier and been transported into the gap between dimensions.」

640:t_3:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「...We've gone and done it...」

640:t_3:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... Now we have no choice but to move forward.」

640:t_3:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You called it an Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier, but...」

640:t_3:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As the name suggests, it's a defensive field that completely covers Earth.」

640:t_3:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The Earth Defense Plan has two pillars: the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 for offense, and $$スヴェル$$ for defense.」

640:t_3:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$スヴェル$$... That's the name of the strongest shield in Norse mythology.」

640:t_3:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, they accepted my suggestion for the name.」

640:t_3:13.en:
$n
(So it uses the same concept as the names of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons...)

640:t_3:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「It doesn't seem to be a simple wall of energy, though...」

640:t_3:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. $$スヴェル$$ distorts the laws of causality on its surface and has the power to suspend laws acting from outside.」

640:t_3:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「Put simply, the space inside it is completely unaffected by outside interference.」

640:t_3:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's why you evacuated the residents of the colonies, $$翠の地球$$, and $$火星$$ to $$蒼の地球$$.」

640:t_3:18.en:
$$シン$$
「That's incredible! It really is an absolute shield!」

640:t_3:19.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's humanity's wisdom applied to defense for you! With this, Earth is safe!」

640:t_3:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's not quite that simple...」

640:t_3:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Unlike the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, which was researched over a considerable period, this was developed in a hurry.」

640:t_3:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「Does it have some kind of flaw?」

640:t_3:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Its concept is the same as the $$時の牢獄$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

640:t_3:25.en:
$$葵$$
「A world where time flows differently... In other words, a world with completely different laws from its surroundings.」

640:t_3:26.en:
$$トライア$$
「Understanding the phenomenon is one thing. Actually doing it is another matter entirely.」

640:t_3:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「So we're basically forcing $$スヴェル$$ into existence with $$次元力$$.」

640:t_3:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's why you used the $$霊子吸収システム$$ and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

640:t_3:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then you made that barrier by putting someone's life in danger!?」

640:t_3:30.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Participation is voluntary, but many people offered to help of their own accord to protect Earth.」

640:t_3:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(So that's why I couldn't find $$ナナリー$$ this past month...!)

640:t_3:34.en:
$$刹那$$
($$沙慈$$, $$ルイス$$... You're in there, too...)

640:t_3:35.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So they're people with powerful spirit quanta... the power of life...」

640:t_3:36.en:
$$トライア$$
「But our technology and knowledge are hastily acquired. Energy extraction is inefficient, and its event control efficiency is nothing to be proud of, either.」

640:t_3:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「Once activated, it's a disposable, single-use system. Its lifespan is a month at best.」

640:t_3:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We have to defeat $$バアル$$ and settle things with the $$御使い$$s targeting Earth within that month...」

640:t_3:40.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. In other words, one month from now will be Earth's last day.」

640:t_3:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, it's understandable... In that battle just now, we saw more than enough of the $$御使い$$s' power.」

640:t_3:46.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$エル・ミレニウム$$ and $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$...」

640:t_3:47.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we can't even fight them properly, defeating the $$御使い$$s is only a dream...」

640:t_3:48.en:
$n
「But... if we can't go back, we have no choice but to move forward...」

640:t_3:49.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The people who stayed behind will protect Earth... Then let's fight.」

640:t_3:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We can't even afford the time to hesitate anymore.」

640:t_3:51.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... Let's go, out into the galaxy.」

640:t_3:52.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's set sail already! Those evil gods, $$バアル$$ and the $$御使い$$s are all waiting for us out there!」

640:t_3:53.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All right...! All ships, prepare for extremely long-range teleportation!」

640:t_3:54.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$, begin communications with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

640:t_3:56.en:
$$スズネ$$
(At last... the final battle for humanity's future is about to begin...)

640:t_3:57.en:
$n
(I'll overcome it all... The future of despair, the fundamental calamity... and fate...)

640:t_3:62.en:
???
(The door opens, and the future closes...)

640:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our wish... We've prepared all this time to make it come true.」

640:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Crushing the $$御使い$$s' minions in today's battle generated 100 Z of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

640:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But the road ahead is steep and endless. Unfortunately, we haven't even reached its entrance yet.」

640:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Given the circumstances, I'll save my congratulations for our ace pilots until another opportunity.」

640:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But we mustn't forget this one thing: let's get down to business, business...」

640:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe those words will save the world...」

640:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our wish... We've prepared all this time to make it come true.」

640:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But the road ahead is steep and endless. Unfortunately, we haven't even reached its entrance yet.」
